feed.title: Feed
feed.mapSoon: Soon you’ll see meetups near you on a map.
feed.cityHint: You can look at meetups in another city too, for example before a trip.
feed.empty: No more meetups here for now. Check back later or create your own.
feed.emptyFiltered: No meetups for these days yet. Try another filter.

meetups.title: My meetups
meetups.body: Your meetups and your requests to join, all in one place.

create.title: New meetup
create.name: Title
create.detailsPlaceholder: What to bring, where exactly you meet, who you're hoping to see
create.timeInChat: We'll agree on the time in the chat
create.searchHint: Start typing a place or an address.
create.searchFailed: Place search isn't answering. Check your internet and try again.
create.costHint: Chip in: roughly what each person pays, for example for renting a table. Paid: the price to take part. Money goes directly between people, not through the app.
create.sentBody: We'll check it and then show it in the feed.

errors.title: Write a title of at least 3 characters.
errors.past: This time has already passed. Choose a later one.

editProfile.title: Edit profile
editProfile.photoHint: Everyone signed in to Vibeish can see your photo.
editProfile.photoPreview: This is how your photo will look in your profile.
editProfile.removePhotoQuestion: Remove the photo from your profile?
editProfile.photoFailed: Couldn't upload the photo. Try another one.
editProfile.aboutHint: A few words about yourself: what you enjoy and what company you are looking for.
editProfile.levelsHint: Tap a hobby to set your level.

beginner.title: Just starting
beginner.hint: Trying it out or started recently

experienced.title: Some experience
experienced.hint: Doing it regularly and with confidence

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.

auth.intro: Find people nearby to play, walk and talk with.
auth.emailHint: We'll send you a code to sign in. No password needed.
auth.codeSent: We sent a code to {{email}}. It can take a minute to arrive, so check your spam folder too.

errors.shortCode: Enter the whole code from the email.
errors.codeInvalid: This code is wrong or has expired. Check it or get a new one.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.emailNotAllowed: We can't send email to this address yet.

about.title: Before we start
about.birthDateHint: Vibeish is only for adults. Nobody else will see your date of birth.

rules.respect: Respect others: no insults, bullying or discrimination.
rules.friendship: Vibeish is for friendship and shared activities. No ads, spam or selling.
rules.safety: Meet in busy public places, especially the first time.
rules.ai: AI checks meetups, profiles and messages. Anything that breaks the rules is hidden, and repeat offenders get their account blocked.
rules.report: Report and block anyone who breaks the rules.

errors.invalidDate: Check the date: day, month and year.
errors.underage: Sorry, Vibeish is only for people aged 18 and over.

profile.title: About you
profile.name: Name
profile.nameHint: Shown on your profile and in chats. A first name is enough.
profile.languagesHint: Others will see them. Choose all that fit.

hobbies.title: What do you love doing?
hobbies.body: Tap a hobby to add your level: it helps you find people at a similar level. You can skip this step and add hobbies later in your profile.

city.title: Your city
city.body: Your feed will show meetups from your city.
city.otherCityHint: We're not there yet. We'll note your city so we know where to go next.

loadError.title: Couldn't load your profile
loadError.body: Check your internet connection and try again.
